paite: Huan kumpipa David in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Pathian telkhiak ka tapa Solomon anaupang lai in bangmah athei nai kei a, asep ding lah athupi ngal a, tempul mihing a ding ahi kei a, TOUPA Pathian a ding ahi zaw hi.
heading: Tempul Lamna Dia Thilpiakte

paite: Huchi in ka Pathian inn a ding in adangka-eng lam thil a ding in dangka-engte, dangkasik lam thil a ding in, dangkasik, dal lam thil a ding in dal, sik lam thil a ding in sik, sing lam thil a ding in sing theih tawk in ka na kisa khinta a, azepna ding onik suang, suang kilawm, asilh ding suang kilawm chi tuamtuam leh suangmantam chi chih leh suangpak suang tampite ka pe khinta hi.

Huai kia lou leng ka Pathian inn ka deihsak mahmah a, keimah sum dangka-eng leh dangkate leng, inn siangthou a dia ka na kisaksa tengteng chih louh, ka Pathian inn a ding in ka pia hi, huai tuh baang zutna ding in ophir dangka-eng,
dangka-eng talent sangthum leh dangkasik siangthou talent sangsagih, azatna lam tuamtuam a misiamte zat ding in, dangka-eng zatna ding a dangka-engte.
Dangkasik zatna ding a dangkasikte ahi. Tuni in TOUPA a ding a kipaktak a pe phal kuakua na om ua?" achi hi.
Huchi in inkuan makaipente, Israel nam heutute, sangkhat heutute leh zakhat heutute, kumpipa nasemte heutute toh kipaktak in apia uhi.
Pathian inn lamna ding dangka-eng talent sangnga leh darik singkhat, dangkasik talent singkhat leh dal talent singkhat-le-sanggiat, sik talent nuaikhat apia uhi.
Suangmantam neite'n TOUPA sum koihkhawmna a Gershon mi Jehiel kep ding in akoih uhi.
Huchi in mipite akipak mahmah ua, lungsim mun khat pu a kipaktak a TOUPA apiak ziak un, kumpipa David in leng nop sak petmah in nuam asa hi.
Huchi in David in mipi tengteng ma ah TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu agen hi,
heading: David In Pathian Apahtawi

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka pu uh Israel' Pathian, tangtawn in phat in om hen. Aw TOUPA, thupina, thilhihtheihna, pahtawina, zohna, lalna nang a ahi a, lei leh van a om tengteng nang a ahi. Aw TOUPA, gam nang a ahi a, mi tengteng atungnungpen na hi.
Hauhsakna leh pahtawina na kiang a kipan ahi, bangkim tung ah thu na nei a, na khut ah thilhihtheihna a-om a, mi tengteng hih thupina leh hatna piaktheihna na khut ah a-om hi.
'Huchi in ka Pathian uh kipahthu ka hon hilh ua, na min thupi ka phat uhi.'
"Himahleh kua ahia ka hih a, ka mite leng kua ahia ahih ua, hiaite kipaktak a ka hon lat theih mahmah uh? Thil tengteng na kiang a kipan a pawt ahi ua, nang a hon pe nawn lel ka hi uhi.
Ka pi-le-pute uh bang in kou zaw na ma ah mikhual, mite kiang a om sam bang ka hi ua; leitung adamsung nite zaw limliap bang lel ahi a, lamet ding himhim a-om kei hi.
TOUPA ka Pathian uh, na min siangthou ding a inn ka hon lamsak ding a hiai thil ka na kisakna tengteng uh nangmah khutsuak ahi a, nang a vek ahi.

Ka Pathian, nang lungtangte na enchian sek a, diktatnate na kipahpih nak chih leng ka thei hi. Ke'n zaw lungsim taktak in hiai thil tengteng kipak mahmah in ka hon lan ahi, hiai lai a kipak mahmah a na kiang a hon lan mite ka muh in ka kipak mahmah hi.
AW TOUPA, ka pu uh Abraham, Isak, Israel' Pathian, na mite'n hichibang lungsim aput gige theihna ding un alungsimte uh nang a ding in hihkip inla;
huan ka tapa Solomon na thupiakte, na thu theihsakte, na dante zui a, huaite tengteng hih ding leh ka kisakkholhna inn lam ding in lungsim hoihkim pusak in," David in achi hi.
David in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Khai le, TOUPA na Pathian uh phat un," achi a, huchi in mipi tengteng in TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian aphat ua, akun ua, TOUPA leh kumpipa abia uhi.

Azing in TOUPA kiang ah kithoihna ding leh TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat ding in bawngtal sangkhat leh belam sangkhat leh belamnou sangkhat, adawn ding uh thillat toh Israelte tengteng a ding in kithoihna tampi alan uhi.
Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA ma ah nuamsatak in ane ua, a-om chiat uhi. David tapa Solomon bel kumpipa ding in abawl tuan nawn ua, TOUPA milian ding in sathau anilh ua, huan, Zadok bel siampu ding in.
Huchi in Solomon TOUPA laltutphah ah apa David sik in kumpipa in atuta a, lamzangtak in a-om a; huan Israelte tengteng in athu azui uhi.
Huan heutute tengteng leh mihat hangsante leh kumpipa David tapa dang tengtengte kumpipa Solomon lak ah akipia uh.
TOUPA'N Israelte tengteng mitmuh in nakpitak in Solomon ahih thupi a, Israel gam a ama a kumpipate lak ah kuamah in atan ngei louh uh, kumpipa hihna thupi mahmah atangta hi.
Jesse tapa David in Israelte tengteng tung ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: David Vaihawm Hun Leh Asihna

paite: Israelte tung a avaihawm sung kum sawmli ahi; Hebron ah kum sagih vai ahawm a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum vai ahawm hi.
Upa tekkun a dam in, hausatak leh pahtawinate tang in asi a; asik in atapa Solomon in vai ahawm hi.
Ngai in, kumpipa David tanchin atung a kipan atawp tan in, zawlnei Samuel laibu, zawlnei Nathan laibu leh zawlnei Gad laibute ah atuang hi.
Avaihawm thute, athilhihtheihdan tengtengte, amah leh Israelte tung leh gam tengteng tung a thil hong omdante toh.
